log_path.description: Path to the shared log file used by the globus-fork-starter program.

mpiexec.description: Path to mpiexec executable or "no" to disable its use for MPI jobs.

mpirun.description: Path to mpirun executable or "no" to disable its use for MPI jobs.

softenv_dir.description: Path to the softenv directory for environment setup; empty string disables softenv support.
